items.text: Fixed a security issue in how zstd-compressed responses are decoded · Added a spinner tip in VS Code and similar integrated terminals about re-running a notebook cell, shown once Claude has read or edited a Jupyter notebook · Added a line under the error shown when your organization's policy blocks a request, saying how to continue: run /rewind and change the message, or run /clear · Added a note for Claude when a sandboxed git checkout, git stash or autostash pull cannot update protected files such as those in .claude
